in_marathi.name: Iniyaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Iniyaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Iniyaa is derived from the Sanskrit term ‘Ishanya’, which means ‘Goddess of Knowledge’. In Hindu mythology, Ishanya is revered as the goddess of wisdom and learning. Iniyaa is a spiritual and intellectual name, symbolizing a deep connection to knowledge and understanding.
